summary: Dashboard query optimizer injects noop filter causing empty resultset and missing trace links on embedded panels
description:
Issue summary: A customer-reported embedded dashboard panel started returning an empty visualization after a retention backfill. Investigation shows the query optimizer injected a redundant noop filter clause into the SQL-like query plan which caused the platform-side join to short-circuit. The panel therefore had zero rows and tracehook link generation skipped because no trace anchor was present.

Impact: Multiple embedded dashboards for BrightHealth Analytics (enterprise) in us-east show blank panels and missing trace links in their product when selecting 7d ranges that cross the retention backfill boundary. This affects internal customers embedding our console in a product-facing status page.

Environment: production, us-east region, console query-engine v3.7.1, retention backfill from 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-09 was running during the window.

Observed at: 2026-03-09 22:40 UTC when customer reported via #support-enterprise Slack.

Expected behavior: Embedded panel returns series and trace link anchors should be present for rows with sampling-enabled traces.

Actual behavior: Panel renders as "No data"; raw query returns empty resultset. Console does not attach trace_hook headers/links.

Workaround: Customer can toggle time-range to exclude the backfill window or disable "optimizer_trim" flag in advanced panel settings (temporary UI toggle we've exposed server-side) to force the legacy query path.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Login to console as org with embedded dashboard (BrightHealth Analytics)
2) Open embedded panel A (Usage heatmap) with time range that includes 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-09
3) Observe panel shows "No data" while surrounding panels show data
4) In developer tools capture the backend query and the planner output from /api/query/run
5) Toggle advanced setting 'optimizer_trim' to off and re-run the panel; panel repopulates data and trace links return

investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 09:20 UTC - Support: reproduced with customer's org and time range; captured planner output indicates an injected noop filter '1=1' that appears with a following join node that returns zero rows.

2026-03-10 12:05 UTC - SRE: retention backfill job running; observed compaction and tombstone sweep overlap during the same window. Hypothesis: optimizer path prunes partitions aggressively when backfill markers present, then adds noop guard to preserve semantics which interacts poorly with join ordering.

2026-03-11 15:40 UTC - Eng (Julian): replicated locally using the backfill fixture. Confirmed optimizer_trim flag toggles between legacy and optimized planner; optimized planner produced noop filter and empty result for a crafted query pattern.
Telemetry: metric console.query.empty_panels_by_org[brighthealth-42] spiked from 2 to 48 between 2026-03-09T22:00 and 2026-03-10T02:00 UTC
Stacktrace: N/A - behavior is planner output / logical transform rather than runtime exception
comments: 2026-03-09 22:55 UTC - George (Support): Customer reports blank embedded panel after scheduled backfill. Asking for query IDs and proof-of-impact. (Slack #support-enterprise thread linked)
2026-03-10 09:30 UTC - Aisha (Support): Attached planner output and suggested workaround (disable optimizer_trim). Customer able to confirm workaround restores panel for immediate needs.
2026-03-10 12:15 UTC - Julian (Eng): Able to reproduce. Marking as In Progress. Looking into optimizer prune/guard logic. Added unit test to reproduce the injected noop case.

2026-03-11 16:00 UTC - Julian (Eng): Root cause narrow: planner rewriter inserts '1=1' guard after partition-prune rewrite; subsequent join reordering assumes non-empty build side and ends up returning zero rows. Patch submitted to guard rewriter to avoid noop injection when join build cardinality can be zero. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8793

2026-03-12 08:45 UTC - Aisha (Support): Notified customer of upcoming hotfix deployment to us-east on 2026-03-13 03:00 UTC; recommended they keep temporary optimizer toggle off until fix is live. Customer acknowledged.
2026-03-12 10:10 UTC - CS (BrightHealth): Asked whether billing impact or data loss occurred. Confirmed no data loss and only display/trace links affected.
resolution_notes: Mitigation applied: exposed 'optimizer_trim' toggle as temporary control for affected orgs; BrightHealth set to 'off' and panels restored.
Fix in review: patch avoids injecting noop guard for queries where partition prune + join reorder can produce zero-cardinality build side. Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8793
Rollout plan: hotfix scheduled to us-east 2026-03-13 03:00 UTC (canary -> regional), monitoring dashboard created for console.query.empty_panels_by_org metric and tracehook_attach_failures.
Follow-ups: Add unit tests covering backfill partition markers, update runbook to include quick toggle for optimizer when backfills are scheduled, and postmortem draft after rollout closure.
